column3: Upon the Vertex HQ Mortgage Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the VRTX 2025-HQ TSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the VRTX 2025-HQ TSA will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to the Mortgage Loan accruing at a rate equal to 0.50000% per annum until the Special Servicing Loan Event (as defined in the VRTX 2025-HQ TSA) no longer exists.
